The [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]] owned an '''apartment''' on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]]<ref name="Sabotage Date">{{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}} places the events of "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]" within the final [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' more specifically dates to [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]].</ref> during the galaxy-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bowmani lived in this apartment with his wife, [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]].<ref name="Sabotage" />
